executive_summary: Unit economics are workable only if average revenue per account clears roughly INR 2,000 per month at a blended acquisition cost under INR 9,000. Both figures are estimates, not measurements. GST treatment of a SaaS subscription must be confirmed with a chartered accountant before any price is published, since the tax treatment changes the net realisation per account.

facts.statement: GST rates, invoicing rules and return-filing obligations applicable to software subscriptions are published on the official GST portal.

assumptions.statement: Roughly 12% of manufacturing SMEs in the target cities will actively seek to replace spreadsheet GST workflows within 18 months.
assumptions.rationale: Shared demand assumption inherited from the market research workstream; not independently validated.
assumptions.validation_method: Same discovery interview programme; do not treat as validated until interviews complete.

assumptions.statement: Monthly logo churn stabilises at or below 3% after the first 90 days of onboarding.
assumptions.rationale: Compliance tooling is sticky once filing history accumulates, but this segment has no observed retention data yet.
assumptions.validation_method: Measure cohort retention monthly from first paying cohort; revisit the model at 6 months.

estimates.metric: average revenue per account per month

recommendations.action: Confirm GST treatment and input tax credit handling for subscription billing with a chartered accountant before publishing prices.
Instrument cohort retention from the first paying customer so the churn assumption can be replaced with measured data by month six.

risks.description: Break-even timing depends on two unvalidated assumptions simultaneously, so the runway requirement could be understated by a wide margin.
risks.mitigation: Hold a 9-month cash buffer beyond the base-case plan and re-forecast at every cohort milestone.
risks.early_warning_indicator: Month-3 churn above 5% or ARPA below the low estimate.

dependencies.note: Demand sizing drives the revenue model.
ARPA estimated top-down here versus bottom-up in market research.

confidence.basis: Tax mechanics are source-backed, but every revenue and cost number is an estimate resting on unvalidated assumptions.

unanswered_questions: What is the realistic annual prepay rate in this segment?
